description: Mada hii inafundisha aina za sentensi (sahili, changamano na ambatano), viungo vya sentensi yaani kiima na kiarifa, pamoja na alama za uakifishaji na matumizi yake sahihi.

mcq.questionText: Sentensi inayobeba wazo kamili moja tu na yenye kitenzi kimoja huitwaje?
mcq.explanation: A simple sentence (sentensi sahili) expresses one complete idea and has only one verb.

mcq.questionText: Katika sentensi 'Mwalimu anafundisha', neno 'Mwalimu' ni sehemu gani ya sentensi?
mcq.explanation: The subject (kiima) is the part that performs the action; here 'Mwalimu' is the doer.

mcq.questionText: Ni alama gani ya uakifishaji hutumika mwishoni mwa sentensi ya kuuliza swali?
mcq.explanation: The question mark (kiulizi) '?' is placed at the end of an interrogative sentence.

mcq.questionText: Sentensi 'Juma alilima shamba na Asha alipanda mahindi' ni sentensi ya aina gani?
mcq.explanation: A compound sentence (sentensi ambatano) joins two independent clauses, here linked by 'na'.

mcq.questionText: Ni alama gani huonyesha hisia kali kama vile furaha au mshangao?
mcq.explanation: The exclamation mark (alama ya mshangao) '!' shows strong feelings such as joy or surprise.

mcq.questionText: Alama ya mtajo (usemi) hutumika kufanya nini katika maandishi?
mcq.explanation: Quotation marks (alama za usemi/mtajo) enclose the exact words spoken by a person.

mcq.questionText: Sentensi 'Nilipofika nyumbani, mama alikuwa amepika' ni sentensi gani?
mcq.explanation: A complex sentence (sentensi changamano) has a main clause and a dependent clause, here introduced by 'Nilipofika'.

mcq.questionText: Katika sentensi 'Watoto wanacheza uwanjani', kiarifa ni kipi?
mcq.explanation: The predicate (kiarifa) tells what the subject does; here it is 'wanacheza uwanjani'.

mcq.questionText: Alama ya ritifaa hutumika kuonyesha nini?
mcq.explanation: The apostrophe (ritifaa) shows a letter or sound that has been omitted, e.g. 'sina' from 'si na'.

mcq.questionText: Ni alama gani hutenganisha vitu vya orodha ndani ya sentensi moja?
mcq.explanation: The comma (mkato) separates items in a list within one sentence.

mcq.questionText: Ipi kati ya zifuatazo ni sentensi sahili?

options.text: Baba amesafiri na mama amebaki nyumbani.

mcq.explanation: Only 'Dada anasoma kitabu' has one verb and one complete idea, making it a simple sentence.

mcq.questionText: Sentensi 'Tafadhali funga mlango.' inaonyesha aina gani ya sentensi kimaana?
mcq.explanation: An imperative sentence (sentensi ya kuamrisha) gives a command or request, like 'Tafadhali funga mlango.'

mcq.questionText: Ni alama gani inayotumika kabla ya kuanza orodha au maelezo zaidi?
mcq.explanation: The colon (koloni/nukta pacha) ':' is used before introducing a list or further explanation.

mcq.questionText: Katika sentensi changamano, kishazi kinachoweza kusimama peke yake huitwaje?
mcq.explanation: An independent clause (kishazi huru) can stand alone as a complete sentence.

mcq.questionText: Ni sentensi ipi imeakifishwa kwa usahihi?
mcq.explanation: The correct version starts with a capital letter, uses a comma after 'Je' and a question mark at the end.

fib.questionText: Sentensi yenye kitenzi kimoja na wazo kamili moja huitwa sentensi _____.
fib.explanation: A sentence with one verb and one complete idea is a simple sentence (sahili).

fib.questionText: Sehemu ya sentensi inayotaja mtendaji wa kitendo huitwa _____.
fib.explanation: The subject (kiima) names the doer of the action.

fib.questionText: Sehemu ya sentensi inayoeleza kile kifanyikacho au alichofanya kiima huitwa _____.
fib.explanation: The predicate (kiarifa) explains what the subject does.

fib.questionText: Alama ya uakifishaji inayowekwa mwishoni mwa sentensi ya taarifa ni _____.
fib.explanation: A full stop (nukta) ends a statement sentence.

fib.questionText: Sentensi 'Wewe ni hodari sana!' imeishia kwa alama ya _____.
fib.explanation: The sentence ends with an exclamation mark (mshangao) to show strong feeling.

fib.questionText: Sentensi inayoundwa na vishazi viwili huru vilivyounganishwa huitwa sentensi _____.
fib.explanation: A compound sentence (ambatano) joins two independent clauses.

fib.questionText: Sentensi yenye kishazi huru na kishazi tegemezi huitwa sentensi _____.
fib.explanation: A complex sentence (changamano) has a main clause and a dependent clause.

fib.questionText: Alama itumikayo kutenganisha maneno katika orodha ndani ya sentensi ni _____.
fib.explanation: The comma (mkato) separates items in a list.

fib.questionText: Alama ya _____ hutumika kuonyesha herufi au sauti iliyodondoshwa kama katika 'hawana'.
fib.explanation: The apostrophe (ritifaa) marks an omitted letter or sound.

fib.questionText: Alama za _____ huonyesha maneno halisi aliyoyatamka msemaji katika hadithi.
fib.explanation: Quotation marks (alama za usemi/mtajo) show the exact words a speaker said.

tf.questionText: Sentensi sahili ina kitenzi kimoja tu na hubeba wazo kamili moja.
tf.explanation: A simple sentence indeed has only one verb and one complete idea.

tf.questionText: Kiima ni sehemu ya sentensi inayoeleza kitendo kilichofanywa.
tf.explanation: False; the subject (kiima) names the doer, while the predicate (kiarifa) explains the action.

tf.questionText: Alama ya kiulizi (?) huwekwa mwishoni mwa sentensi ya swali.
tf.explanation: True; the question mark ends an interrogative sentence.

tf.questionText: Sentensi ambatano huundwa na kishazi huru kimoja tu.
tf.explanation: False; a compound sentence is made of two or more independent clauses.

tf.questionText: Nukta hutumika mwishoni mwa sentensi ya kawaida ya taarifa.
tf.explanation: True; a full stop ends an ordinary statement sentence.

tf.questionText: Alama ya ritifaa hutumika kuonyesha hisia kali za furaha.
tf.explanation: False; strong feelings are shown by the exclamation mark; the apostrophe (ritifaa) shows omitted letters.

tf.questionText: Sentensi changamano ina kishazi huru na angalau kishazi tegemezi kimoja.
tf.explanation: True; a complex sentence combines a main clause with a dependent clause.

tf.questionText: Mkato hutumika kuonyesha mwisho kamili wa sentensi.
tf.explanation: False; a comma shows a pause; the full stop shows the end of a sentence.

tf.questionText: Alama za usemi hutumika kuandika maneno halisi yaliyosemwa na mtu.
tf.explanation: True; quotation marks enclose a speaker's exact words.

tf.questionText: Kila sentensi lazima iwe na kiima na kiarifa ili iwe kamili.
tf.explanation: True; a complete sentence requires both a subject and a predicate.

summary.questionText: Aina kuu tatu za sentensi kwa muundo
summary.correctAnswer: Sentensi sahili, sentensi changamano na sentensi ambatano.
summary.explanation: These are the three main structural sentence types in Kiswahili.

summary.correctAnswer: Sehemu ya sentensi inayotaja mtendaji au kinachozungumziwa.
summary.explanation: The subject names the doer or what is being talked about.

summary.correctAnswer: Sehemu ya sentensi inayoeleza kitendo au hali ya kiima.
summary.explanation: The predicate explains the action or state of the subject.

summary.correctAnswer: Huonyesha mwisho wa sentensi ya taarifa.
summary.explanation: The full stop marks the end of a statement.

summary.correctAnswer: Hutenganisha vitu vya orodha na kuonyesha kituo kifupi.
summary.explanation: The comma separates list items and shows a short pause.

summary.correctAnswer: Huwekwa mwishoni mwa sentensi ya swali.
summary.explanation: The question mark ends an interrogative sentence.

summary.correctAnswer: Huonyesha hisia kali kama furaha, mshtuko au mshangao.
summary.explanation: The exclamation mark shows strong feelings.
Quotation marks show a speaker's exact words.

summary.correctAnswer: Huonyesha herufi au sauti iliyoachwa katika neno.
summary.explanation: The apostrophe marks an omitted letter or sound.

summary.questionText: Tofauti kati ya sentensi ambatano na changamano
summary.correctAnswer: Ambatano huunganisha vishazi huru; changamano huunganisha kishazi huru na tegemezi.
summary.explanation: Compound joins independent clauses; complex joins an independent and a dependent clause.

hoq.questionText: Geuza sentensi sahili 'Mtoto analia' kuwa sentensi ambatano sahihi.

options.text: Mtoto analia kwa sababu ana njaa.

hoq.explanation: Option B joins two independent clauses with 'na', forming a compound sentence; the others are simple or complex.

hoq.questionText: Ni sentensi ipi iliyoakifishwa kwa usahihi ikionyesha usemi halisi?
hoq.explanation: Option A correctly uses a comma before the quote, capital letter inside, and a full stop within the quotation marks.

hoq.questionText: Katika sentensi 'Kwa kuwa mvua ilinyesha, mashindano yaliahirishwa', tambua kishazi tegemezi.
hoq.explanation: 'Kwa kuwa mvua ilinyesha' cannot stand alone and depends on the main clause, so it is the dependent clause.
